title: Device address outside the PLC subnet
summary: The PLC cannot reach a device: its IP address was changed to another subnet and no gateway is configured.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.body: The PLC cannot reach a device: its IP address was changed to another subnet and no gateway is configured.

symptoms: Connection status: no route or timeout
diagnosticMethod: Ping the device from the PLC side
repair: Restore the documented device address or correct the configuration
troubleshooting.explanation: Without a gateway a device can only reach addresses in its own subnet; ARP requests for other subnets are never answered.
